svg.title: Preserve expert information and student preferences

cc:Work.dc:title: Preserve expert information and student preferences
cc:Work.dc:description: Illustration, not measured results. Student and expert response distributions differ. Shading marks responses that meet the expert semantic constraints. New training data preserves the student relative preferences within that set.
